## Checklist

- [ ] I opened or linked an issue before starting a large change.
- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one concern.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks and listed them below.
- [ ] I updated docs when setup, configuration, commands, or user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I regenerated GraphQL/server/frontend artifacts if schema or generator inputs changed.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, tokens, Plaid credentials, account numbers, real transaction details, emails, database contents, private URLs, or other PII.
